seo.title: EVB Player · Free player that remembers your place in every file
seo.description: Play a folder of videos or audio in order and resume every file where you stopped: online courses, lectures, audiobooks. Free and offline for Mac, Windows and Linux.
seo.ogDescription: Play your media folders in order. Offline on macOS, Windows, and Linux.
seo.ogImageAlt: EVB Player playing a video from a media folder

hero.title: Play your media folders in order
hero.lede: Turn any folder of numbered videos or audio files into a playlist that remembers your place. Free and offline on macOS, Windows, and Linux.

downloads.web: Or open EVB Player in your browser, with nothing to install

mac.title: Apple Silicon
mac.note: Signed and notarized by Apple. Open the DMG and drag EVB Player to Applications.

win.title: Windows 10 and 11
win.note: The installer is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may ask you to confirm. Choose More info, then Run anyway.

linux.title: Ubuntu and Debian
linux.note: Install with sudo apt install ./ followed by the file name. Updates ask for your password before installing.

demo.ariaLabel: EVB Player opening a folder from the Library, playing a video, marking another video as watched, switching videos, filling the window with the video, and returning to the Library while it keeps playing.
demo.caption: Recorded from the real app with generated demo videos.

folders.title: Folders become playlists
folders.text: Files are sorted by their numbers and subfolders become sections. Nothing is copied, converted, or uploaded.

durations.title: Durations up front
durations.text: The length of every file and of the whole folder is read when it opens, before you play anything.

resume.title: Resume where you stopped
resume.text: Your position in every file is saved as you watch or listen. Finished files are ticked off and the next one starts.

skip.title: Skip what you know
skip.text: Mark any file as done without playing it, or reset one file or a whole folder.

order.title: Your own order
order.text: Reorder tracks, star favorites, hide what you don't need and add tracks from other folders. The files on disk stay as they are.

window.title: Tabs and full window
window.text: Keep several folders open in tabs. Theater mode, full window, fullscreen, speed control and keyboard shortcuts for everything.

courses.title: Online courses
courses.text: Work through a course you downloaded, lesson by lesson. Every video remembers where you stopped, and the folder shows how far you've got.

lectures.title: Lectures and talks
lectures.text: Recorded lectures, conference talks and tutorials play in the order of their file names, with a section for each subfolder.

audiobooks.title: Audiobooks
audiobooks.text: A book split into dozens of files plays in order and resumes in the right chapter, even weeks later.

languagePractice.title: Language practice
languagePractice.text: Listening practice and video lessons for a language you're learning, with speed control and a quick ten-second replay.

free.question: Is it free?
free.answer: Yes. EVB Player is free and open source under the MIT license, with no ads, accounts or subscriptions.

files.question: Are my files uploaded anywhere?
files.answer: No. The desktop app reads your folders directly and keeps its progress on your computer. The browser version plays your files in the browser; nothing leaves your device.

order.question: In what order does it play files?
order.answer: By the numbers at the start of file names, so 10 comes after 9, not after 1. Subfolders become sections. You can also reorder a playlist yourself.

formats.question: Which formats does it play?
formats.answer: Plays MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM, MP3, M4A, AAC, FLAC, WAV, Ogg, and Opus. Files the built-in player can't decode, such as AVI, open in your usual media player.

windows.question: Windows says “Windows protected your PC”. Is it safe?
windows.answer: The Windows installer isn't code-signed yet, so Windows warns about an unknown publisher. Choose More info, then Run anyway. The app is built from its {sourceCode}.

browser.question: Can I use it without installing anything?
browser.answer: Yes, in the browser at {browserUrl}. Chrome and Edge remember your folders between visits; in other browsers you choose the folder again.

updates.question: How does it update?
updates.answer: The desktop app checks for new versions and asks you before it downloads one.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.metaDescription: Learn how EVB Player handles your media, progress and website data.
privacy.media: EVB Player never uploads your media. The desktop app reads your folders directly and keeps your progress, playlists and settings in files on your computer. The browser version keeps them in your browser's storage.
privacy.updates: The desktop app connects to the internet only to check GitHub for new versions.
privacy.analytics: This website counts page views and downloads to learn how people find it. For each one it records the page's language, the platform, the country (from the network), the website you came from, and an anonymous code that changes every day. It stores no IP addresses or browser details and sets no cookies for this.
privacy.cookies: The website uses three small cookies: one for the theme you chose, one for your system's light or dark setting, and one for your language.
